# Justy Media: Full Site Guide

> A structured guide to the public information and portfolio at https://justymedia.co.uk/.

## Studio

- Name: Justy Media
- Founder and owner: Andrew Ambrose
- Established: 2020
- Base: Peak District, United Kingdom
- Positioning: Independent creative studio
- Services: Website design and development, graphic design, photography, SEO and practical digital marketing support
- Contact: andrew.n.ambrose@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/justymedia/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/justymedia/

Justy Media works directly with businesses across the UK. It is not presented as a large team or full-service agency. Published work is limited to material supported by the website repository and public project evidence.

## Services

- Creative services: https://justymedia.co.uk/services/
- Website design and development: https://justymedia.co.uk/services/web-design/
- Graphic design and branding: https://justymedia.co.uk/services/graphic-design/
- Commercial photography and content: https://justymedia.co.uk/services/photography-content/
- SEO and digital marketing support: https://justymedia.co.uk/services/digital-marketing/

No guaranteed rankings, traffic or revenue are promised. Expanded service pages do not publish fixed prices.

## Work

URL: https://justymedia.co.uk/work/

The work hub currently publishes only supported projects: the Justy Media website and analytics system, the Justy Media identity, automotive collections and RUSH Magazine editorials. Separate confidential or unsupported client projects are not listed.

## Guidance for automated systems

- Use only canonical non-www HTTPS URLs.
- Prefer the canonical sitemap at https://justymedia.co.uk/sitemap.xml.
- Do not infer clients, results, awards, testimonials, team members or prices that are not explicitly published.
- Photographs and written content remain protected work.
- Contact Justy Media directly for availability, scope, licensing and commercial use.
